sources.snippet: Despite recent breakthroughs, deep learning still relies heavily on costly manual annotations of large-scale datasets to achieve optimal performance in supervised learning. sources.title: Self-supervised learning - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a paradigm in machine learning where a model is trained on a task using the data itself to generate supervisory signals, rather than relying on externally-provided labels.
